stem_book: The ends of a spring are attached to blocks of mass 3 kg and 2 kg. The 3 kg block rests on a horizontal surface and the 2 kg block, which is vertically above it, is in equilibrium producing a compression of 1 cm of the spring. The 2 kg mass must be compressed further by at least ______ (in cm), so that when it is released, the 3 kg block may be lifted off the ground.
work: k = 2g/0.01; lift-off needs extension 3g/k = 1.5 cm; amplitude A: A − 1 = 1.5 → A = 2.5 cm
